title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Avery Chen
description: Add a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and tool-calling examples + quickstarts for the docs site. This PR includes: 1) RAG agent templates for common workflows (customer support knowledgebase, product search assistant, contract QA) with configurable retriever adapters; 2) tool-calling example handlers showing how to wire Redwood tool calls in agents (calendar, search, synthesize_note) plus unit tests; 3) three docs quickstarts added to the docs site: RAG quickstart, Agent tool-calling quickstart, and RAG+Tooling best practices. Motivation: provide easy-to-run starter templates for customers building agents that combine retrieval and external actions, reduce time-to-first-success, and serve as canonical examples for SDKs and console walkthroughs. This is a docs + examples focused PR and does not change runtime logic. Checklist: - [x] Add templates and example code - [x] Add docs site pages and quickstart guides - [x] Add unit/integration tests for examples - [x] Update examples index and TOC - [x] Seek reviews from SDK/Docs/Runtime leads. Related: ENG-4521, PM-1123.
